concrete_question: Do all authenticated public primary EMC methylation arrays show a lower cumulative mitotic-associated methylation signature (primary candidate epiTOC2, exact published probes/formula subject to applicability authentication) than source/array-matched primary FFPE translocation-associated soft-tissue sarcomas, and does any contrast survive supplier/array batch and tumor-purity controls sufficiently to justify a useful new EMC epigenetic-state observation?
novelty_required: A measured reproducible signature contrast with interpretable cancer applicability, beyond the already published EMC diagnostic methylation class/flat CNV; no de novo cluster or partner/outcome subgroup without metadata.

comparison_selection_before_values.EMC: All 10 GSE140686 reference EMC plus every authenticated relevant condition discovered in other public methylation studies; validation sample 54 is reclassified SEF, not an additional EMC.
comparison_selection_before_values.primary_controls: All available same-study primary FFPE sarcoma records in the fixed histologic classes synovial sarcoma, myxoid liposarcoma, low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma and sclerosing epithelioid fibrosarcoma; contrast within shared array platform and supplier/slide where available, without selecting controls by observed scores.
comparison_selection_before_values.technical_controls: All primary FFPE sarcoma metadata used to diagnose platform/batch/supplier/purity comparability; normal tissue only for signature calibration context, never substitute EMC.
comparison_selection_before_values.age: No age/proliferation causal interpretation; absence of individual age or independently measured mitotic state may defeat interpretable burden comparison.
comparison_selection_before_values.donors: Source-defined independent cases only, preserve repeated conditions and cross-study overlap uncertainties.

strongest_alternative: Apparent EMC difference reflects age, cell-type lineage, tumor mixture, supplier/array batch or invalid transport of a normal-tissue mitotic clock into fusion-driven sarcoma; low score is not proof of low current proliferation.
defeat_rule: Shelve if no cancer/sarcoma-applicable signature with sufficient shared probes/formula, no matched controls or source-independent corroboration, age/purity/batch could fully explain the contrast, no orthogonal or useful state interpretation, prior art already establishes it, or remaining suitable EMC evidence is unevaluated. A descriptor alone is not publication-worthy.
staged_cost: First metadata/primary-method/novelty/source-size gate only; no biological methylation values before this freeze. Retained raw soft cap64MiB, >=10GiB free. Notify lead before larger matrix download; exact signature and finite streamed/subset analysis require additive stage contract, no invisible EMC omission.
coverage: All identifiable relevant public EMC methylation specimens/conditions, including historical diagnoses and larger sarcoma collections; statuses explicit. A discovery catalogue is not evaluation.
